items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Hal McIntyre, a lot of musicians...

ctx.x: been terrible, because I lasted for one performance and they changed it back again. Yeah, it’s fun. But the best part was coming into Chicago.

Did you see any of the - I mean there was a lot of jazz musicians that of course were drafted in the service. Did you run across any of those musicians of that time? I know Joe, once again Joe Wilder’s one of those individuals that come to mind, because the Philly connection, but of course he ended up enrolling or volunteering for the Marines. But there are a lot of... Hal McIntyre, a lot of musicians...
I didn’t meet any famous ones.
